text:
Corporate treasury may be where tokenised real-world assets become real.

On the latest Crypto Minutes on Bloomberg TV, Re7 Founder & CIO Evgeny Gokhberg hosts Yuval Rooz, Co-Founder and CEO of Digital Asset, the company behind Canton Network, on the next phase of finance moving on-chain.

For Yuval, RWAs have always been the most compelling use case on-chain, and corporate treasury is where that becomes real. His expectation is specific:

"You're going to start seeing corporates on Canton very soon using yield products that can be liquidated in real time into tokenized deposits or stablecoins. They'll start doing treasury management using on-chain finance."

For allocators, the question this raises is operational rather than conceptual: what corporate treasury functions need in order to move on-chain, from real-time liquidity into tokenized deposits or stablecoins to the infrastructure that connects them.

The full episode is linked in the comments.
